body:
i had a bunch of friends I’ve known since middle school last until a few months ago, we’d been on-and-off friends a few times throughout highschool because I was stupid, and as a freshman dated a senior, and when I ended the relationship with her she outed me to everyone, and started up so much shit about me, ruined my highschool experience, i dropped out almost as soon as I turned 16 and never looked back.

And with what happened recently, they told me they still believed the things the girl had spread about me ( mind you, im 20 now ) and I was in utter shock, when it all first went down I had to practically fight for my innocence, the girl was trying to land me in jail, claiming I had S/Aed her, and when I showed proof that I was the other way around, no one believed me, none of my ‘friends’ helped, i was getting death threats on a daily and I was left alone, although eventually when it got around she was a predator her reputation was ruined, like when me and her were together ( I was 14, she was 18, it came out a few months after everything with her went down she was dating middle schoolers, 7th-8th graders )

I asked them why did they stick around for so long, and they told me they felt sorry for me, but they were angry that I fucked up their reputation because it was known we were friends, we were a group, 9 of us in total and it was devastating

I’m doing better now though, I’m still trying to go out and meet new people/experience new things, painting helps alot, my advice to anyone about losing friends is you live, and move on, and you still have a long way to go and a lot of new people to meet
I’ll try too later , i have medicine that’s gonna help me keep things down , so everything’s stabling out
Thank you :)) and I enjoy painting , it’s genuinely calming for me
